description:
Get current Polymarket probabilities for a natural-language event question.
    Returns a conservatively matched market and source links. For Polymarket
    executable quotes use list_executable_opportunities or get_executable_quote.
    Kalshi comparisons are available on https://voxodds.com/polymarket-vs-kalshi only.

question.description: Natural-language question about a future event, e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates in December?'
question.title: Question

name: get_market_odds
title: Prediction-market odds for an event
